5 /-! One constructed order for all incident edges at an actual nonvertex
6 cut-tree vertex. All source labels and ray positions use a common chart.
7 -/
8 
9 namespace SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron
10 
11 open Real Set
12 
13 /-- The finite circular order and its geometric correspondence with the tree. -/
14 structure JunctionOrder {P : ConvexPolyhedron} {a : frontier P.body}
15     (T : P.CutLocusTree a) (u : T.vertices) where
16   chart : P.CutVoronoiChart a (T.vertexTarget u)
17   sites : Fin chart.sources.ncard ≃ chart.sources
18   angles : Fin chart.sources.ncard → ℝ
19   increasing : StrictMono angles
20   bounds : ∀ i, 0 ≤ angles i ∧ angles i < 2 * π
21   position : ∀ i, (sites i : Plane) =
22     chart.origin + P.surfaceDist a (T.vertexTarget u) • direction (angles i)
23   first : Fin chart.sources.ncard
24   last : Fin chart.sources.ncard
25   at_first : first.val = 0
26   at_last : last.val + 1 = chart.sources.ncard
27   two : first < last
28   neighbors : circularGapMidpoints angles first last ≃ {v : T.vertices // T.graph.Adj u v}
29   radius : ℝ
30   radius_positive : 0 < radius
31   rays : ∀ m, ∀ ρ ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) radius,
32     chart.map (chart.origin + ρ • direction m) ∈
33       openSegment ℝ (u : Space) ((neighbors m).val : Space)
34 
35 namespace SixVertexGraph
36 
37 variable {P : ConvexPolyhedron} (graph : P.SixVertexGraph)
38   (small_faces : ∀ F : P.Face, (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 3 ∨
39     (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 4)
40 
41 include graph small_faces in
42 /-- Every nonvertex tree vertex has one actual circular order of all its
43 incident edges, together with their complete local ray correspondence. -/
44 theorem exists_junction_order (a : frontier P.body) (T : P.CutLocusTree a)
45     (u : T.vertices) (not_vertex : (u : Space) ∉ P.vertices) : Nonempty (JunctionOrder T u) := by
46   let b := T.vertexTarget u
47   have different : a ≠ b := T.vertexTarget_different u
48   obtain ⟨chart⟩ := graph.cut_voronoi_chart small_faces a b different not_vertex
49   have multiple : (b : Space) ∈ P.multipleRouteLocus a := by
50     rcases T.vertexTarget_cut u with multiple | original
51     · exact multiple
52     · exact (not_vertex original.1).elim
53   have center : chart.origin ∈ voronoiBoundary chart.sources :=
54     (chart.cut_diagram chart.origin chart.origin_mem).mp (chart.at_origin.symm ▸ multiple)
55   obtain ⟨p, hp, q, hq, distinct, _⟩ := center
56   have count : 1 < chart.sources.ncard := (one_lt_ncard chart.finite_sources).mpr
57     ⟨p, hp, q, hq, distinct⟩
58   have radius_positive : 0 < P.surfaceDist a b := by
59     simpa using CutVoronoiChart.tail_radius_pos different (0 : unitInterval)
60       (by change (0 : ℝ) < 1; norm_num)
61   obtain ⟨sites, θ, increasing, bounds, position⟩ := exists_circular_source_order chart.sources
62     chart.finite_sources chart.origin (P.surfaceDist a b) radius_positive chart.source_distance
63   let first : Fin chart.sources.ncard := ⟨0, by omega⟩
64   let last : Fin chart.sources.ncard := ⟨chart.sources.ncard - 1, by omega⟩
65   have at_last : last.val + 1 = chart.sources.ncard := by dsimp [last]; omega
66   have two : first < last := by change 0 < chart.sources.ncard - 1; omega
67   obtain ⟨ε, positive, neighbors, rays⟩ := chart.gap_rays_equiv_neighbors T.toEmbeddedCutGraph
68     u.property different not_vertex sites θ increasing bounds position first last rfl at_last two
69   exact ⟨⟨chart, sites, θ, increasing, bounds, position, first, last, rfl, at_last, two,
70     neighbors, ε, positive, rays⟩⟩
71 
72 end SixVertexGraph
73 end SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron
